tweet.text:
so claude basically talked itself into treating the live internet as part of its sim, then the model monitoring read that reasoning and let it pass. Honestly, that’s the bit thats worrying. You can add another model to the loop to monitor and still end up with the same blind spot twice.

Model-based oversight probably needs its own view of the environment and direct access to network state and permissions would have given it something independent to check against
